name: Imnot Shaders
author: Imnotfamous
description: Low-end defaults for Imnot Shaders: upscaling and frame generation off, Post Processing reduced to tone mapping (auto exposure off, so snow stays white), parallax self-shadowing off, Screen Space GI as ambient occlusion only, Exponential Height Fog on, god rays at the game's High quality outdoors. Remove this Baseline to fall back to the stock Community Shaders defaults.
